description:
Get Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a gene.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_go — one record = one direct GO annotation record of one gene.
Key: id, go[].id, go[].aspect, go[].evidence, go[].source, go[].geneProduct.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by go[].id asc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one direct GO annotation record of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.go_membership` counts go_memberships; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.term` counts terms.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Direct GO annotations, not propagated.

aspect.description: C: cellular component; F: molecular function; P: biological process.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
